facts.fact: 与 Sean FaceTime 三个多小时——训练营晚饭有严格作息，他六点必须走。
facts.anchor: Dinner time in the barracks has a strict schedule.

facts.fact: 两人心照不宣：他从不问为何不回信——双方都在回避那段旧账。
facts.anchor: He never asked why I didn’t reply to his letters when he was in basic training.

facts.fact: 她在餐厅跟调酒客打情骂俏解闷——内疚，也动了「干脆放他走」的念头（原计划本就如此）。
facts.anchor: I’m doing exactly what I said I didn’t want to do.

facts.fact: Eloise 烧烤局开场嘲讽：「跟你男朋友聊完啦？」
facts.anchor: “Done talking with your boyfriend?” She snickers.

facts.fact: Eloise 升级羞辱：拿绳子牵着走的傻男孩——她骂完自己都不知道说了什么。
facts.anchor: the boy you pull along on a little string like a hoe bag

facts.fact: Eloise 双杀：他太好了你配不上；你在餐厅浪费人生。
facts.anchor: he is probably too good for you anyhow. You waste your life at that restaurant

facts.fact: 父亲也在挨刀：Eloise 长期贬低管理酒馆的他——他每晚躲在办公室独自喝一杯看电视。
facts.anchor: He knows it was a dig at him too.

facts.fact: 父亲额头吻 + baby girl——与 ch01 门口的呼喊同一句。
facts.anchor: “Hi, baby girl,” he says, kissing me on the forehead.

facts.fact: 父亲把最大的一块牛排先给她。
章末判词：爱父亲，但一刻也待不下去——离开的倒计时在走。
facts.anchor: I love my dad—but I can’t wait to get out of here.
